mentions.name: Homeschooling in India book
mentions.description: A book (work in progress) about the author's family's homeschooling experiment in India, expanding blog posts and talks answering common questions into a draft; two chapters written so far and available to read online.
mentions.problem: Homeschooling in India is not widespread, so the author received many questions about what they were doing, which the book aims to answer.
mentions.source_excerpt: Now I've written quite a few posts (and given talks), I thought of writing a book. Just wrote two chapters. The draft lives here: https://www.jjude.com/books/hs/
